 E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced the dates of events: May 16­
Teen Summit; May 22­Memorial Day Event; that the pool will be open for recreational swim and
swimming registration on Memorial Day weekend; and that youth baseball registration is now open.

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced that they will hold a catalytic converter engraving event
on May 16.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Director, announced that Waste Management became the waste
service provider on May 1; that the next block cleanup will be held on June 27; provided updates on the
Carson Street and Pioneer Blvd Resurfacing Project; HAWK Traffic Safety Project; and the Golden
State Waterline Replacement Project; and announced that Public Works week is next week.

Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director, provided an update on the ERP software.

F.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no City Attorney Reports.

G.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember De Paula requested an e­bike safety awareness update and Teen Center outreach
strategies for programming.

Steve Gomez provided an update on e­bike safety.

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, provided an update on the Teen Center
outreach strategies.

Mayor Pro Tem Roa asked about Lee Ware camp participants.

Councilmember Vargas spoke.

H.  CLOSED SESSION

There were no Closed Session items.

I.  ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting at 7:14 PM to the next Regular City Council meeting to be held
on Wednesday, May 27, 2026 at 6:00 PM.
